dialogue_history.content: How should "digital natives" be defined? The knowledge base has "Digital Channel Opportunity" (low onlineuse/mobileuse but high BRS and produsescore), but that's the opposite of a digital native. Should digital natives be customers with high digital engagement (chaninvdatablock.onlineuse = 'High' OR mobileuse = 'High')? And what threshold defines "high engagement" for the engagement score (e.g., CES >= 0.7)?

Yes, "digital natives" should be defined as customers with high digital engagement, specifically where `chaninvdatablock.onlineuse = 'High' OR chaninvdatablock.mobileuse = 'High'`, combined with `autopay = 'Yes'`. For "high engagement," the threshold is a Customer Engagement Score (CES) greater than 0.7 (i.e., `ces > 0.7`).

args.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    cr.coreregistry,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM (cr.scoredate - (cr.tenureyrs || ' years')::interval)) AS cohort_quarter,
    LEAST(ca.produsescore,1.0) AS prod,
    LEAST(ca.chanusescore,1.0) AS chan,
    LEAST(bt.bankrelscore,1.0) AS brs,
    LEAST(ca.custservint/10.0,1.0) AS cs,
    (bt.chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' OR bt.chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High') 
      AND (bt.chaninvdatablock->>'autopay' = 'Yes') AS is_digital_native
  FROM core_record cr
  JOIN employment_and_income ei ON ei.emplcoreref = cr.coreregistry
  JOIN expenses_and_assets ea ON ea.expemplref = ei.emplcoreref
  JOIN bank_and_transactions bt ON bt.bankexpref = ea.expemplref
  JOIN credit_and_compliance cc ON cc.compbankref = bt.bankexpref
  JOIN credit_accounts_and_history ca ON ca.histcompref = cc.compbankref
),
scored AS (
  SELECT cohort_quarter, is_digital_native,
    0.4*prod + 0.3*chan + 0.2*brs + 0.1*cs AS ces
  FROM base
)
SELECT 
  cohort_quarter,
  is_digital_native,
  COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,
  ROUND(AVG(ces),4) AS engagement_score,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN ces>0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS pct_high_engagement,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN ces>0.7 AND is_digital_native THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_digital_native THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS pct_high_eng_digital_native,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN ces>0.7 AND NOT is_digital_native THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_digital_native THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS pct_high_eng_non_digital_native
FROM scored
GROUP BY cohort_quarter, is_digital_native
ORDER BY cohort_quarter, is_digital_native;

parts.text: Now let me build the full query with CES, cohort quarter, digital native flag, and aggregations.

args.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    cr.coreregistry,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM (cr.scoredate - (cr.tenureyrs || ' years')::interval)) AS cohort_quarter,
    LEAST(ca.produsescore,1.0) AS prod,
    LEAST(ca.chanusescore,1.0) AS chan,
    LEAST(bt.bankrelscore,1.0) AS brs,
    LEAST(ca.custservint/10.0,1.0) AS cs,
    (bt.chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' OR bt.chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High') 
      AND (bt.chaninvdatablock->>'autopay' = 'Yes') AS is_digital_native
  FROM core_record cr
  JOIN employment_and_income ei ON ei.emplcoreref = cr.coreregistry
  JOIN expenses_and_assets ea ON ea.expemplref = ei.emplcoreref
  JOIN bank_and_transactions bt ON bt.bankexpref = ea.expemplref
  JOIN credit_and_compliance cc ON cc.compbankref = bt.bankexpref
  JOIN credit_accounts_and_history ca ON ca.histcompref = cc.compbankref
),
scored AS (
  SELECT cohort_quarter, is_digital_native,
    0.4*prod + 0.3*chan + 0.2*brs + 0.1*cs AS ces
  FROM base
)
SELECT 
  cohort_quarter,
  is_digital_native,
  COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,
  ROUND(AVG(ces),4) AS engagement_score,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN ces>0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS pct_high_engagement,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN ces>0.7 AND is_digital_native THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_digital_native THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS pct_high_eng_digital_native,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN ces>0.7 AND NOT is_digital_native THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_digital_native THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS pct_high_eng_non_digital_native
FROM scored
GROUP BY cohort_quarter, is_digital_native
ORDER BY cohort_quarter, is_digital_native;

    LEAST(ca.produsescore,1.0) AS prod,
    LEAST(ca.chanusescore,1.0) AS chan,
    LEAST(bt.bankrelscore,1.0) AS brs,
    LEAST(ca.custservint/10.0,1.0) AS cs,
    ((bt.chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' OR bt.chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High') 
      AND (bt.chaninvdatablock->>'autopay' = 'Yes')) AS is_digital_native
  FROM core_record cr
  JOIN employment_and_income ei ON ei.emplcoreref = cr.coreregistry
  JOIN expenses_and_assets ea ON ea.expemplref = ei.emplcoreref
  JOIN bank_and_transactions bt ON bt.bankexpref = ea.expemplref
  JOIN credit_and_compliance cc ON cc.compbankref = bt.bankexpref
  JOIN credit_accounts_and_history ca ON ca.histcompref = cc.compbankref
),
scored AS (
  SELECT cohort_quarter, is_digital_native,
    0.4*prod + 0.3*chan + 0.2*brs + 0.1*cs AS ces
  FROM base
),
grp AS (
  SELECT cohort_quarter, is_digital_native, COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,
    AVG(ces) AS engagement_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ces>0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_cnt
  FROM scored GROUP BY cohort_quarter, is_digital_native
)
SELECT cohort_quarter, is_digital_native, cohort_size,
  ROUND(engagement_score,4) AS engagement_score,
  ROUND(100.0*high_cnt/cohort_size,2) AS pct_high_engagement,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN is_digital_native THEN high_cnt ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_quarter)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_digital_native THEN cohort_size ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_quarter),0),2) AS pct_high_eng_digital_native,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_digital_native THEN high_cnt ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_quarter)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_digital_native THEN cohort_size ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_quarter),0),2) AS pct_high_eng_non_digital_native
FROM grp ORDER BY 1,2;
